messages:
maya_cs: Heads up on Heliotherm renewal 12mo with split invoicing across two entities (US and EU). Procurement demands separate POs per entity, vendor code, and the CFO wants Net75. Can Ops/Legal confirm feasibility?

tonysales: AE says they'll accept 12mo if we allow split invoicing and keep price flat. They can issue two POs same day. Asking about discount? No discount requested.

frank_fin: Split invoicing is OK but we need both billing entities mapped in Stripe/SFDC and vendor codes. Net75 is unusual  finance needs approval from revenue ops. Also need GL codes per entity.

neha_legal: Main legal ask: extend indemnity cap for EU entity to 02M and add a data processing addendum for EU logs. We can do DPA but indemnity cap increase requires legal/exec signoff. Also need to verify signer delegation if POs come from procurement team, not CFO.

nora_ops: Operational note: our hosted offering can keep embeddings/logs in EU region for the EU billing entity, but cross-entity analytics may aggregate in US. If they require separate model serving clusters per entity, that's a dedicated infra lift.

maya_cs: Procurement just sent two POs (US PO: PO-US-7788, EU PO: PO-EU-3344) and vendor codes (HT-US-11, HT-EU-11). They also attached an email from Procurement signed by Head of Procurement, not CFO. Are delegation emails acceptable?

neha_legal: Delegation acceptable if the PO or an attached email expressly states the authorized signer and is from corporate domain. If procurement signs, we need a quick confirmation from CFO or a board resolution. Acceptable: scanned delegation email OR DocuSign with matching signer email.

frank_fin: Received POs. Will queue split invoices once legal confirms delegation and revenue ops ok with Net75. Need GL codes and billing contacts per entity.

tonysales: AE can get CFO confirmation this afternoon. Also asked whether we can include a short 'hosting residency' clause in SOW.

neha_legal: Draft clause: "Redwood will store and process Customer Data for EU Billing Entity within EU regions. Logs related to the EU Billing Entity shall not be transferred outside the EU except as required by law." I will add indemnity cap proposal in redline and circulate.

nora_ops: If they want separate clusters, timeline ~3 weeks and cost delta +20%. If hosted EU region only, no extra infra.

maya_cs: Timeline: target signature and invoices by next Friday COB. Tony to get CFO confirmation on delegation and revenue ops to sign off on Net75. I'll drop final checklist here.

frank_fin: Tagging revenue-ops for Net75 approval. Once approved I'll issue invoices per PO numbers and email remittance instructions to the procurement contact.

neha_legal: Posting redline in DM. If delegation comes as email from CFO domain, legal can approve quickly. Otherwise we escalate.

maya_cs: Thanks 14 will update after CFO confirms. Please flag any blocking issues here. :calendar:
